script_text: The cosmic stars are igniting a dangerous power surge for Taurus this week. Early week brings a deeply tense Mars square Pluto aspect in your 10th House of Career, causing intense financial pressure on Tuesday. Mercury sextile Venus in your 1st House keeps your analytical mind sharp, but the tension remains entirely real. Your midweek turning point occurs when Venus enters Gemini, activating your 7th House of Love and partnerships. By late week, a soothing Jupiter trine elevates your Earth element. It brings emotional calm and weekend relief to your 4th House. Thursday is your ultimate power day because Venus conjuncts Mars in your 7th House, sparking a passionate romantic connection. Tuesday is your worst day because Mars square Pluto triggers a brutal career setback and monetary loss. You must firmly ground your Earth energy through daily meditation to attract stability. Follow for daily updates.
